title: Papillons - No. 5

legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #29776 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1887), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~98%, pitch ~90% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op2_papillons_5.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Papillons Op. 2.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
